product_name: Retail Real Estate Finance - Property Takaful (All Risks)
description: Property Takaful linked to SIB mortgage finance for residential or commercial properties, protecting the bank/customer interest against accidental loss or damage to the financed property.
eligibility: Customers with eligible SIB-financed residential property

Property type/construction subject to insurer underwriting
features: Sum insured generally up to AED 100 million subject to category limits
